from flask import Flask, render_template, request
from jinja2 import Template

app = Flask(__name__)

@app.route('/apply-them', methods=['POST'])
def apply_them():
    them = request.form.to_dict()
    base = request.form['base']

    template = Template("{{ base }} applied to {{ them }}", autoescape=True)
    party = template.render(base=base, them=them)
    party = party.replace(' ', ' ')
    party = party.replace('people', '<people>')

    return render_template('party.html', party=party)
